enablement_program_and_maturity_content: move through each rollout wave with confidence by aligning governance, security, communications, enablement, and support.
We will co-build one repeatable enablement program with UHG’s Fabric team and Enterprise L&D, equipping users, activating champions, scaling user groups, and refining the playbook for each cohort.
In practice, this connects intake and provisioning, approved use cases, champion activation, continuing education, adoption metrics, and operational handoff
into a model UHG can sustain beyond the engagement
adoption_takeaway: Insights, feedback, and measured value from one early adopter inform the next, accelerating adoption while strengthening governance, trust, and responsible use.
title: UHG’s Fabric value will come from how employees use approved tools in governed workflows, not from deployment alone. Success requires a repeatable operating model, intentional enablement, and disciplined measurement across each rollout wave.
